conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hi! I just got my new credit card, and I’m so happy! How do I activate it?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s great to hear, ma’am! You can activate it via the app or I can do it for you. Do you have the card number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yes, it ends in three two eight four. Can you activate it now?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Absolutely. Your card is activated. You can start using it immediately.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Wow, that was fast! Thank you so much!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: You’re welcome! Let me know if you need help with anything else.
